newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Slovenian firms want ties with Yugo economy - paper.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian firms want ties with Yugo economy - paper.

text.p: Slovenian companies have expressed great interest in normalising economic ties with the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, a Slovenian official was quoted as saying by Belgrade newspaper Borba on Tuesday.

"Slovenian firms are exerting pressure on the Slovenian Chamber of Commerce and other government institutions to resume and develop economic relations," Slovenian Chamber of Commerce Vice President Cveto Stantic was quoted as saying.
Stantic said Slovenian companies, especially those that have partners in Yugoslavia, would like to convene a business conference to discuss prospects and means for cooperation under new conditions.
He said the Slovenian chamber is trying to organise such a conference in Ljubljana.
"There have been some contacts, although mainly personal ones, among representatives of the Belgrade, Novi Sad and Ljubljana chambers," Stantic said.
In 1996, trade between companies from the two countries amounted to around $130 million.

"This is statisfactory in view of the absence of regulations on political and dipomatic relations, inter-state agreements on economic cooperation or bilateral payments operations," Stantic was quoted by Borba as saying. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
